import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD_A = 998244353L;
    static final long MOD_B = 1000000007L;
    static final long[] powers = {1L, 10L, 100L, 1000L, 10000L, 100000L, 1000000L};
    static long[] sumArr = new long[7];
    static long result = 0;
    static long countSeq1 = 0;
    static long maxNum;
    static long countSeq2 = -1;
    static List<Long>[] sequences = new ArrayList[7];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        maxNum = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            sequences[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        buildSequences(0, 0L);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(sequences[i]);
        }
        traverse(0, 0L);
        System.out.println(result);
    }

    static void buildSequences(int depth, long val) {
        if (depth == 7) return;
        long modVal = (countSeq1 - val + MOD_A) % MOD_A;
        sequences[depth].add(modVal);
        sumArr[depth] += modVal;
        countSeq1++;
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            buildSequences(depth + 1, val * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static boolean checkRange(long x) {
        return x * powers[6] + 999999L <= maxNum && x * powers[6] * 10 > maxNum;
    }

    static void traverse(int level, long currentValue) {
        if (currentValue > maxNum) return;
        if (checkRange(currentValue)) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long p = ((countSeq2 + 1 - (currentValue * powers[i]) % MOD_A) + MOD_A) % MOD_A;
                List<Long> seq = sequences[i];
                int pos = lowerBound(seq, MOD_A - p);
                long size = seq.size();
                long sumSeq = sumArr[i];
                long contribution = (sumSeq + p * size - MOD_A * (size - pos)) % MOD_B;
                result = (result + contribution) % MOD_B;
            }
            countSeq2 += countSeq1;
            return;
        }
        countSeq2++;
        long addVal = ((countSeq2 - currentValue) % MOD_A + MOD_A) % MOD_A;
        result = (result + addVal) % MOD_B;
        int startDigit = (level == 0) ? 1 : 0;
        for (int digit = startDigit; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            traverse(level + 1, currentValue * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }
}
